settingsAbout.title: About Kamp.la
settingsAbout.paragraph1: Kamp.la is a community-driven discovery app that lets you explore campsites, RV parks, and nature spots across Turkey on a map, mark the places you've visited, and share your experiences with the community.
settingsAbout.paragraph2: Our mission is to make it easy for nature lovers to find reliable, up-to-date location information, and to build a map that grows and is verified through every user's contribution. Adding a new location, sharing a photo, or rating a place all make this map more useful for everyone.
settingsAbout.paragraph3: Our vision is to make Kamp.la the most comprehensive and trusted camping/RV discovery platform in Turkey, connecting campers with each other and fostering a nature-respecting, sustainable discovery culture.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.draftNotice: ⚠️ This text is a draft; legal review is required before publishing.
terms.intro: These Terms of Use govern your use of the Kamp.la mobile app and website ('the Service'). By accessing or using the Service, you agree to these terms.
terms.section1Body: You need an account to use some features of the Service (adding locations, writing reviews, creating lists, etc.). You are responsible for making sure the information you provide during registration is accurate and up to date, and for keeping your account and password secure.
terms.section2Body: The location information, photos, reviews, and ratings you add to the app ('User Content') belong to you. By sharing this content on Kamp.la, however, you grant Kamp.la a non-exclusive, worldwide, royalty-free license to display, store, and distribute this content as part of the Service.
terms.section3Body: You may not post content that is misleading, defamatory, infringes copyright, violates personal privacy, or could harm nature. Location-focused photos are expected instead of selfies or personal photos. Content that violates these rules may be reviewed and removed by administrators.
terms.section4Body: Kamp.la is a community-generated map. The accuracy of location details (coordinates, amenities, season, etc.) is not guaranteed. We recommend verifying up-to-date information before visiting a place. Kamp.la cannot be held liable for damages arising from inaccurate or outdated information.
terms.section5Body: Kamp.la Plus (premium) membership is a paid subscription offering additional features (unlimited lists, advanced filtering, etc.). Subscription fees, renewal terms, and cancellations are subject to the payment terms of the store you use (App Store/Google Play).
terms.section6Body: We reserve the right to warn, suspend, or permanently close accounts that violate these terms. You may also permanently delete your own account at any time from the 'My Account' page; this action cannot be undone.
terms.section7Body: Kamp.la does not guarantee that the Service will be uninterrupted or error-free. Camping/RV activities in nature involve inherent risks; Kamp.la cannot be held responsible for these risks or for incidents at third-party facilities.
terms.section8Body: We may update these terms from time to time; we will notify you in-app of significant changes. For questions, contact us at support{'@'}kamp.la.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.draftNotice: ⚠️ This text is a draft; legal review is required before publishing.
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains what data we collect when you use Kamp.la, how we use it, and your rights.
privacy.section1Body: When you create an account, we collect your username, email address, and password (stored encrypted). You may optionally add a profile photo and social media links. We also store the locations, photos, reviews, and lists you add while using the app.
privacy.section2Body: If you use the automatic GPS positioning feature, we request access to your device's location; this permission is only used while adding a location/browsing the map, and there is no background tracking without your consent.
privacy.section3Body: Your data is used to manage your account, provide the core functions of the app (map, favorites, lists, notifications), improve service quality, and fulfill our legal obligations.
privacy.section4Body: Your data may be shared to a limited extent with infrastructure providers that help us deliver the Service (e.g. hosting, database, payment infrastructure). Your data is not sold to third parties for advertising purposes.
privacy.section5Body: Your data is retained for as long as your account is active. When you permanently delete your account from the 'My Account' page, your associated personal data is deleted from our systems (except data we are legally required to retain).
privacy.section6Body: Under applicable law (e.g. GDPR), you have the right to access, correct, delete, and object to the processing of your data. You can contact us to exercise these rights.
privacy.section7Body: Cookies/similar storage technologies are used for essential functions such as keeping you signed in and remembering your language preference.
privacy.section8Body: We take reasonable technical and administrative measures to protect your data. For privacy-related questions, contact us at support{'@'}kamp.la.
